newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Taeil shrs jump on new development news.
newsitem.headline: Taeil shrs jump on new development news.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Taeil Media Co rose 6.6 percent to 16,100 won by midday on Wednesday on news that the company had developed a multi-function engine for office machines, brokers said.
The stock briefly hit this year's high of 16,300 won per share, which is the stock's daily upper limit.
A statement from Taeil, the world's biggest maker of magnetic heads for computer disk drives, said the engine can function as a laser beam printer, facsimile machine, image scanner and copy machine.
The statement said Taeil expected to record more than $300 million in domestic and overseas sales per year.
Taeil ranked second in the morning's list of most actively traded stocks, with 836,130 shares changing hands.
